card.name: Start of Re- and C- section headings
card.fires_on: The first piece of a word beginning with Re or C (Reye, Reconstitution, Re-initiation, CYP, Coadministration) right after a section number or heading start in drug label text.

modes.label: Re- heading after section number
modes.description: The piece Re starts a heading word right after a numbered section like 2.6 or 4.3.

modes.label: C at start of CYP or Coadministration
modes.description: The letter C starts CYP enzyme names or Coadministration after a heading or label.
